data.name: Lulu Dimensional Leaper
data.detailed_description:
Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Master! A 2D Warp Action Adventure!

Use Lulu's warp ability and the powers of her companions to dash through stages with speed and style!

A lighthearted metafictional story about you, the Player, and Lulu, a girl with the power to manipulate space.

■Warp Action

Lulu can freely perform short-range teleports!

* Pass through thin walls

* Run up walls to reach higher places

* Slide the moment you land

* Chain together rapid teleports along Warp Rails

All of these actions are performed using only movement controls and the jump button!

Master Lulu's warp ability and fly through each stage however you like.

■Companion Ability System

Lulu can't attack on her own.

Instead, she'll rely on the companions she meets throughout her adventure!

Each companion grants a unique ability that can be assigned to the A, X, or Y button, including:

* Fire projectiles for ranged attacks

* Ice blades for close-range combat

* Light based invincibility

All of these abilities can be used with a single button and very few restrictions!

And if certain conditions are met, you can unleash flashy Special Moves!

■A Story About You—The Player—Meeting Lulu

A girl with an extraordinary Ability wanted just one thing—"a friend."

The World

A world where everyone possesses some kind of "Ability."
The story takes place in a certain town where particularly powerful Ability users have gathered.

There, people live under the watchful eye of the world's strongest Ability user, known as the "Sage."

Lulu, the Spatial Ability User

Lulu lives in this town and possesses the "Spatial" Ability, which allows her to freely teleport short distances.

Her remarkable Ability has made her well-known around town, and she dreams of becoming a hero.

Every day, she warps around town, helping anyone who happens to be in trouble.

"You," the Player

When the game begins, Lulu speaks directly to the screen.

"Could you be the player!?"

Lulu can recognize the existence of "you."

As you fight, play, and talk together—
the distance between the two of you slowly begins to change.

The Evil Organization, "Darkworld"

A mysterious evil organization known as "Darkworld" has appeared in town.

Use Lulu's warp abilities and your own power to defeat the evil organization.

The Mysteries of the World

Why can Lulu recognize "you"?

What exactly is the evil organization?

What is really happening in this world?

And then—
What will Lulu choose in the end?

This is a bright metafictional story with multiple happy endings,
beginning with the encounter between "you" and Lulu.

—I'm going to be a hero in this town.
　I won't leave anyone in trouble behind.
　With my warp ability and your power, we'll help everyone, from one end of town to the other...!

■Controls

Move: D-Pad / Arrow Keys
Jump / Warp: B Button

Ally Abilities: A / X / Y
Abilities unlock as you progress through stages.

■Community / Discord

Feel free to drop by our official Discord as well.
You can share your thoughts after playing, report bugs, or casually check in on development progress.

The game is still in development, so feel free to join whenever you like.

👉 Join through the social links on the Steam store page.

data.short_description: Warp through stages at high speed and overwhelm your enemies in an easy-to-play, exhilarating 2D action game! Enjoy cool action from a cute heroine, plus plenty of quirky, meta, and lighthearted dialogue.
